pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is largest on the upper shoulder and neck, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed regions on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section but appears narrower towards the lower limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude blurred silhouette along the dorsal midline. Specific individual hair tufts are not resolvable due to image resolution.
